question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Bliss
solution: The correct answer is '**Joy**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Bliss**' is '**Joy**'. • **Bliss**: perfect happiness. (परमानंद, चटम सुखा) • *Example: She gave a sigh of **bliss**. * • **Joy**: a feeling of great happiness. (हर्ष, ख़ुशी, आह्लाद, आनंद) • *Example: We’d like to wish you **joy** and success in your life together.* **Correct Answer:__** *Joy.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Pain**: the unpleasant feeling that you have when a part of your body has been hurt or when you are ill. (शरीर के किसी अंग पर चोट या किसी रोग से पीड़ित होने के कारण उत्‍पन्‍न दर्द; पीड़ा, वेदना) • **Bane**: something that causes trouble and makes somebody unhappy. (परेशानी का कारण, दुःख का कारण) • **Educated**: having studied and learnt a lot of things to a high standard. (शिक्षित, उच्‍च शिक्षा प्राप्‍त) 1bc:T9a8, The correct answer is** 'regardless'.**
